ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, the diameter $AB$ of the circle $\odot O$ is $2$, point $C$ is on the circumference of the circle, and $\angle CAB=30^\circ$. Point $D$ is a moving point on the circle, $DE\parallel AB$ intersects the extension line of $CA$ at point $E$, and $CD$ is connected, intersecting $AB$ at point $F$. As shown in Figure 1, when $DE$ is tangent to $\odot O$, what is the degree measure of $\angle CFB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} As shown in the figure: Connect OD\\
$\because$ DE is tangent to $\odot$O\\
$\therefore \angle$ODE$=90^\circ$\\
$\because$ AB $\parallel$ DE\\
$\therefore \angle$AOD$+\angle$ODE$=180^\circ$\\
$\therefore \angle$AOD$=90^\circ$\\
$\because \angle$AOD$=2\angle$C\\
$\therefore \angle$C$=45^\circ$\\
$\because \angle$CFB$=\angle$CAB$+\angle$C\\
$\therefore \angle$CFB$=\boxed{75^\circ}$

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The attached figure contains two circular geometric diagrams, Figure 1 and Figure 2. In Figure 1, AB is a horizontal diameter, O is on AB and is the center of the circle, A is at the left end, and B is at the right end; C is at the upper right of the circle; D is at the lowest point of the circle; the line DE passing through D is a horizontal line, is parallel to AB, and is tangent to the circle at D; the extension of CA intersects this horizontal line at E in the lower left; segment CD intersects AB at F. The problem asks for the measure of ∠CFB in Figure 1. Reasoning according to the specified coordinate method: Let O=(0,0), and let AB be the x-axis. Since the diameter AB=2, the radius is 1, take A=(-1,0), B=(1,0), and the circle is x^2+y^2=1. In Figure 1, DE is the horizontal tangent line parallel to AB, and it is tangent below the circle, so the point of tangency is D=(0,-1). Also ∠CAB=30°, the ray AC starting from A makes an angle of 30° with the positive x-axis, and the slope is tan30°=1/√3, so the equation of AC is y=(x+1)/√3. Intersecting with the circle x^2+y^2=1, other than A=(-1,0), gives C=(1/2,√3/2). Connect C and D. The slope of line CD is (√3/2-(-1))/(1/2-0)=√3+2=2+√3. Since F is at the intersection of CD and the x-axis AB, ray FB is along the positive x-axis direction, and the angle that ray FC makes with the positive x-axis is arctan(2+√3). Because tan75°=2+√3, ∠CFB=75°.
